_comment: Last-resort rates, used only when open.er-api.com is unreachable AND nothing is cached. Units of each currency per 1 USD. Deliberately committed rather than fetched at build time so the posting form never breaks. These go stale — NGN, GNF, ZWG and AOA move fast — so anything rendered from this table must be labelled approximate and dated. Regenerate with: node scripts/refresh-fallback-rates.js
